limitations.note: The agent correctly held `s3_d011` across invalid cycles, but also changed two exits from `s4_d0110` to reuse the final zero, producing overlapping match pulses where the expected FSM returns to idle.
The exhaustive test used a rolling-history oracle that expected overlapping matches, so it accepted the extra pulses instead of catching the regression.
A whitespace-sensitive patch and then a Python edit with a failed assertion made no changes, so the agent had to attempt the edit a third time.
